notes.title: Lux Delux 6.6 update
notes.notes: Lux Delux version 6.6 is now available on steam. This update increases the font size when viewing maps very large. It also eliminates a bug some users were having downloading the list of extra maps. Enjoy!

notes.title: Update for Linux and overlay compatibility
notes.notes:
We just updated Lux Delux to fix an issue that some Linux users were reported, with the game not starting properly.

This update also furthers our work on making Lux Delux work better with the Steam overlay on Windows computers. Please let us know how the overlay is working for you with this update.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update for overlay issues
notes.notes: We just published an update to Lux Delux that makes it work better with the steam overlay. If you've previously turned off the steam overlay for Lux, please try turning it back on, and let us know how it works for you now. :)
